question: Which memory-wiki isolation contract should OpenClaw support for shared-gateway multi-agent setups: plugin-owned per-agent vault routing, generic agents.list[].plugins overrides via #55401, or explicitly unsupported shared-gateway memory-wiki isolation?
rationale: The choice controls sensitive memory visibility, config precedence, plugin SDK shape, CLI/gateway behavior, and upgrade expectations, so source evidence can prove the gap but cannot choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design plugin-owned vault isolation
options.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent or context-aware vault contract first, coordinating with but not blocking on the broader generic per-agent plugin config issue.

options.title: Wait for generic plugin overrides
options.body: Keep this issue open behind #55401 and solve memory-wiki through a shared agents.list[].plugins precedence, validation, and lifecycle contract.

options.title: Document unsupported shared-gateway isolation
options.body: Leave memory-wiki global for now and document separate gateways or separate installs as the supported hard isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Design plugin-owned vault isolation
recommendation.body: Add a memory-wiki-owned per-agent or context-aware vault contract first, coordinating with but not blocking on the broader generic per-agent plugin config issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans plugin config runtime, security-sensitive memory isolation, and upgrade/doctor semantics where recent history points most strongly to this owner.
